title: S8 preregistration counts cost by token type and controls noise and grader access
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/sector-sweep-1119/report.md sections "S2 Proof", "Cost split"; operator approval 2026-11-19 (memory s8-prereg-amendment-grant).
Outcome: ADR 0021 amended, then evals/replay/abc.prereg.md gains: cost by token type (uncached/cached/output) from logged tokens with one fixed price vector plus cache-price sensitivity (today session-result.ts:213 uses total_cost_usd only); interleaved paired runs on the same units with a three-state verdict; infra-error flag + exclusion rule; grader outside the agent's write scope, regrade from clean checkout, touched tests/CI = unresolved; rule for quota-truncated runs; per-repo strata; report intervals not ranks; one A/A arm (19% flip rate, arXiv 2611.19359).
Proof: `node --test test/evals/replay-cost.test.ts` passes, asserting per-token-type cost rows and the A/A arm in the prereg.
